newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends down on cenbank dlr put auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends down on cenbank dlr put auction.

text.p: The Mexican peso came off its lowest levels at the close Thursday due to heavy dollar inflows into the record-breaking bourse, but still closed softer on a central bank move to curb the peso's recent strength, dealers said.
"The market was volatile due to Banco de Mexico upping its dollar put auction to $500 million from $300 million," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate ended the session 2.75 and 2.2 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.8130/7.8175 and 7.8040/7.8090 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had earlier closed 5.80 centavos weaker at 7.8080/7.8130 per dollar.
